description: This file defines a custom exception class ResourceNotFoundException used in a Spring Boot application to handle cases where a requested resource cannot be found, associated with HTTP 404 responses.

classes.name: ResourceNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating a resource was not found, annotated to produce a 404 NOT FOUND HTTP status.

methods.name: ResourceNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with resource name, field, and lookup value, constructing a detailed message.

methods.name: getResourceName
methods.description: Returns the name of the resource that was not found.

methods.name: getFieldName
methods.description: Returns the name of the field used for lookup.

methods.name: getFieldValue
methods.description: Returns the value used for lookup.
